The moon is up, the stars have come.
Your pillow’s soft, your covers deep —
A comfy nest for little sleep.

And One who loves you even more
Is closer than your bedroom door.

He knew it long before you came.
You’re loved for who you are inside,
With loving arms stretched open wide.
